description:
[Broker Sync API] Prop-firm platform integration registry — live-verified methods (Topstep ProjectX API, FTMO MatchTrader bridge) and connection status.

Use when you want the registry of prop-firm platforms and which integration methods are live-verified. Not for a user's own accounts (use broker_sync_connections).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: broker_sync_prop_firms
